display.description: End City Survey quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: End City Survey

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
End City Survey is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: A shell and a Chorus Flower. The village has heard stories. Now it has evidence. Your name will travel farther than the road.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: I also need one Chorus Flower, intact if possible.
missing_proof: Bring a Shulker Shell. The city has to leave a hard signature.
missing_target: A shell alone is not a survey. Reach the End City itself.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Sanity remains undefeated for another day. A rare result.
The last map edge is not an edge. It is a dare written in empty ink.
I have a survey no sane cartographer files twice: an End City, a shell, and a living sample.

responses.label: I will survey the End City.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: End City near {target_x}, {target_z}. Shulker Shell for proof, Chorus Flower for study. Try not to let the void edit the report.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: End City Survey is already settled.
locate_failed: The End refuses a clean mark today. Even maps know when to hesitate.
started: The city mark is {direction}, about {distance} blocks from here, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a Shulker Shell and one Chorus Flower.
unavailable: This survey waits for someone the village can trust with impossible directions.

lines: You have the look of someone who saw the map run out and kept walking. Did you bring proof?
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
